spans.text: In case of error, clearly explain the issue
spans.note: The prompt follows a structured, transparent process where each step is clearly displayed to the user. It instructs to 'Always display a clear summary of each step' and 'In case of error, clearly explain the issue,' promoting transparency about what is happening and what went wrong.

spans.text: If any checks fail, display the details and ask the user if they want to continue anyway
spans.note: The prompt demonstrates good tool safety practices by requiring user confirmation before destructive actions like merging and creating releases. It checks CI status before proceeding and asks the user if they want to continue when checks fail. However, it does use --delete-branch automatically as part of the merge command.

spans.text: If they want to add a custom comment on the PR before merging
spans.note: The prompt strongly preserves user agency throughout the workflow. It asks for user confirmation before merging, requests custom messages, asks about version bumps, and never proceeds with consequential actions without explicit user consent. The AskUserQuestion tool is used at multiple decision points.
